item.author: invalid@example.com (t.lamprecht)
item.dc:creator: t.lamprecht
item.content:encoded:
Recent security findings and fixes in Ceph make it necessary to upgrade ceph and migrate authentication keys from the aes to the aes256k cipher. This is to address weaknesses in the old Cephx authentication method, especially if your Ceph service networks are not isolated. Upgrading to Ceph Tentacle 20.2.4 or newer, or Ceph Squid 19.2.6 or newer, will trigger new Cephx health errors and warnings for the old aes type.
